rule: An entry exempts one eval unit type (eval family + unit field) ONLY when that unit is a CONTEXT CORPUS the item is judged against (evidence, premise, retrieval candidate pool), drawn from a shared public corpus our sources also use. Units that are part of the item being judged (claim, statement, question, hypothesis, product, function specs, conversation) are never exempt: shared public text there FAILS. Every exempted row is counted per entry and per draw (allowlist_saved). Adopted by the coordinator 2026-10-09.

entries.corpus: English Wikipedia (2017 introductory paragraphs, the HotpotQA/HoVer dump)
entries.justification: HoVer evidence is Wikipedia paragraphs; the same paragraphs appear in NQ passages, BoolQ evidence, background_reading filler and hover training evidence. The audit (analysis/NGRAM_TEST_AUDIT_2026-10-09.md) verified leaf by leaf that the overlap is the shared Wikipedia text and that no HoVer claim (the item, unit S:claim, not exempt) is covered.

entries.corpus: English Wikipedia lead sentences/paragraphs (ANLI R1/R2 premises are Wikipedia leads)
entries.justification: ANLI's premises are Wikipedia passages; our NQ passages, clinc150/when2call background_reading filler and anli training premises draw on the same Wikipedia text. The 6-gram audit verified the shared text is the premise and that no hypothesis is covered. CAVEAT: the Index puts premise AND hypothesis in the same instructions unit, so this entry also exempts the hypothesis from this gate; item copies stay covered by SplitGuard (content hash) and the item-level n-gram audit.
entries.reviewed: 2026-10-09 B (D1-24k doc-overlap scan: 72 rows, all Wikipedia-premise coverage)

entries.corpus: ToolRet's candidate tool pool: tool documentation aggregated from public tool-use datasets (ToolACE, Glaive, API collections)
entries.justification: ToolRet-retrieval's instructions carry the candidate tool documents; ToolRet built that pool from public tool-use datasets that our toolace / glaive_fc / when2call training sources come from, so tool specs match by construction. The ToolRet item is the query (unit S:query, not exempt), which is never covered.
